editorial.blurb: A 51-year Mexican institution serving exceptional handmade margaritas and vibrant house-made salsas alongside crowd-pleasing tacos, quesabirria, and tortilla soup.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a pitcher of their signature fresh margaritas on the rocks to share—reviewers rave about them, and the owner famously treats walk-ins to complimentary warm chips and housemade salsa.
